_comment: Curated reference for Midnight (WoW 12.x) embellishments. Two detection paths: item_ids covers pre-embellished gear (fixed item ID = the embellished item itself); bonus_ids covers optional-reagent embellishments (crafted base item + a bonus ID added by the reagent). bonus_ids must be populated from in-game data / Wowhead once confirmed - WCL surfaces bonus IDs via COMBATANT_INFO bonus list. Needs per-patch maintenance. NOT part of the rulebook - do not add to prompts/.

bonus_ids._comment: Bonus IDs that optional-reagent embellishments add to crafted items. Populate from WCL raw gear payload inspection or Wowhead item bonus data once confirmed. Example: { '12345': 'Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt' }. Known reagent item IDs (not bonus IDs) for reference: Arcanoweave Lining=240167, Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt=245876, Darkmoon Sigil: Blood=245871, Darkmoon Sigil: Rot=245877, Darkmoon Sigil: Void=245873, Blessed Pango Charm=244603, Primal Spore Binding=244607, Devouring Banding=244674.
